name: Kawasaki KZ1000
engine: 1,015 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: The Z1's bigger brother. A tough engine; most trouble comes from past owners and tired charging parts.

F: The stock regulator and rectifier are separate units. Test both before buying parts.
B: Owners on KZRider say careless past owners cause most problems. Check every bolt and wire as you strip it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Past owner work
known.what: Owners say careless previous work is the most common problem.
